explanation: This lemma has no counterpart in Mathlib. `Scheme.connectedComponentOpen` is the library's own definition and does not appear in this Mathlib version (searching Mathlib for "connectedComponentOpen" found nothing). The library defines it as the preimage of `{c}` under `ConnectedComponents.mk`. The lemma just unfolds that definition and is proved by `rfl`. The only Mathlib facts involved would be generic ones such as `Set.mem_preimage` and `Set.mem_singleton_iff`, which do not count. All of the content is in the library's own definition.
